title: Quartered bias input
statement: Given a restricted-weight input, define its quarter-bias input to have the same output dimension and bias numerator, and a bias denominator equal to four times the original denominator. The resulting input has positive dimension, positive bias numerator, and bias at most one half.
hypotheses_covered: The input contains a small-bias input with positive dimension and positive bias numerator, whose bias is at most one half
The input has a natural-number Fourier bound at least one
